comments.body: `promiseAll` is called here but never imported. The file (`packages/medusa/src/subscribers/order.js:1-50`) has no `import` or `require` at all, and the PR only swapped `Promise.all` for `promiseAll` on this line. The `.js` file isn't type-checked, so `tsc` won't flag it. When the `order.placed` event fires, `handleOrderPlaced` throws `ReferenceError: promiseAll is not defined`. Discount `usage_count` is then never incremented for any placed order. Fix: add `import { promiseAll } from "@medusajs/utils"`.
